dct_description_sm: This project will develop new integrated ocean, wave, and ice models in the Beaufort Sea to improve forecasting of weather and ocean conditions in the region. By adding an ocean forecast model to the existing atmospheric model, weather forecasts will better represent the dynamic interactions between the ocean, ice, and the atmosphere in the Arctic. This initiative is part of an integrated modelling program that will provide a science and technology-based foundation to expand the Canadian modelling and forecasting system to produce marine information products for the Beaufort Sea. It will build on ongoing work at Environment Canada and Fisheries and Oceans Canada to develop an operational coupled ocean-wave-ice-atmosphere prediction system. The forecasts produced will support oil and gas activities by providing forecast information for planning and operations such as infrastructure planning, transport safety and efficiency, offloading, evacuation, and ice management.
dct_title_s: Forecasting Extreme Weather and Ocean Conditions in the Beaufort Sea
